controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: GEBCO land and seafloor heights
controls.description: GEBCO_2026 terrain model. Colors show meters above and below mean sea level; relief is shaded for readability. Ocean depths combine measured and estimated terrain. Land includes the ice surface.
controls.summary: GEBCO_2026 modeled terrain. Colors show height and depth relative to mean sea level; ocean depths include estimates.

controls.label: Night lights
controls.title: Black Marble night-light composite
controls.description: NASA Black Marble 2016 night-light composite. This archival observation does not depict current lighting.
controls.summary: Artificial lighting is combined from observations taken in 2016. The composite does not show present-day lighting.

controls.label: ENSO
controls.description: NASA MUR · 1 km source imagery · 7 Sept 2026. Sea-surface temperature departure from the 2003–2014 average. NASA colors saturate below −3 and at +3 °C. Gray: land, ice, or unavailable imagery.
controls.title: ENSO: sea-surface temperature anomalies · 7 Sept 2026

controls.label: Cross section
controls.title: Interior structure model
controls.description: Schematic interior based on NASA Science. Layer boundaries and colors illustrate the model; this is not direct interior imaging.
controls.summary: Colored layers distinguish the crust, mantle and core. Their boundaries follow a structural model, not interior photographs.
